name: Proxima Centauri B findings (Collection)
description: Two objects were recovered from Proxima Centauri b, and both produce sound continuously by means that have no counterpart among our instruments. B2311.22 came up from a dry cistern at Kell Rille — its sound is the vibration of its own connectedness, and energy put into it does not decay in place but travels through the structure. It did not come up alone: a second body lay beside it, and on raising the first the second changed pitch. B2311.67 was recovered 123 days later from a vault field of sixty-seven at the Sabik Terminator, each at the centre of its own void; it is a lattice rather than a body, perfectly ordered and never repeating, and its sound belongs to a category between tone and noise that no material we have made produces. Neither object has controls, and neither has an off state. What the hand meets is a three-dimensional section through a four-dimensional body; move the section and a different part is simply present. Field findings included, with the six questions the survey could not close.
note: Windows VST3 · field record B2311 · 2 of 2 recovered · findings report included.
